name: relay
description: A quiet notebook for project context. Optional nested folders, boards and templates, plus an Agent notebook: ask Relay in plain language, see what your agents add, and share notes with them.
releaseNotes: Relay is now agent-ready. Ask Relay with the @relay language or a free-form request, see to-dos, reminders and context from your agents in a new From agents list with due chips and snooze, and share any note with agents in one click. Items you save with @relay now appear in All notes and Pinned, marked “via @relay”, and update live. The Agent notebook is on for every project by default and can be switched off per project in Settings → Extensions. Your notes stay local; nothing is shared until you share it or create it through Ask or @relay.

listing.externalServices: None. Notes, project logos, attachments, and Trash stay in local extension profile browser storage. Items you share or create through Ask or @relay are stored in Tabs on this computer. No telemetry or cloud sync.
